messages:
Talia: Quick note: noticed a cluster of streaming sessions where the console token breakdown omits ~1-2 chunks but ledger shows them. Repro after we enabled truncate-prealloc in canary yesterday.
Ben: ugh. sample trace?
Talia: trace=prealloc-444, shard=us-east-1, router=canary-prealloc. Excerpt: 
Talia: ```
[2026-06-08T12:03:01Z] session=prealloc-444 client-truncate offset=80
[2026-06-08T12:03:01Z] router allocated ledger_tag=lt-222 prealloc=true
[2026-06-08T12:03:02Z] client reconnect start (no idempotency header)
[2026-06-08T12:03:03Z] chunk-acked offset=80 ledger-tag=lt-222
[2026-06-08T12:03:03Z] chunk-acked offset=80 ledger-tag=lt-223
```
Iris: Looks like prealloc allocated a tag, but reconnect created another confirmed toolcall with a different tag. Duplicate attribution.
Vik: Are we preallocating on client-truncate path and also on toolcall-confirm? Could be double allocation race.
Talia: SQL to find suspects: 
Talia: ```sql
SELECT session_id, offset, array_agg(distinct ledger_tag) as tags
FROM stream_acks
WHERE timestamp > '2026-06-07'
GROUP BY session_id, offset HAVING cardinality(array_agg(distinct ledger_tag)) > 1;
```
ops-bot: alert: "metering_prealloc_dup_rate" fired (0.7%). Incident INC-7999 created.
ops-bot: assigned to @oncall.
Ben: mitigation options: 1) stop prealloc in canary (rollback); 2) switch prealloc to be idempotent keyed by session+offset; 3) reconciliation: dedupe ledger by (session,offset) within 500ms window.
Iris: prefer 2) + 3). Rolling back loses the optimization gains. Short-term, make prealloc return a deterministic tag when same session+offset seen.
Vik: cheap implementation: prealloc store is a small LRU in router keyed by (session,offset) with TTL 30s. If exists, return existing tag. Pseudocode: 
Vik: ```go
key := fmt.Sprintf("%s:%d", sessionID, offset)
if tag := preallocCache.Get(key); tag != nil {
  return tag
}
tag := allocateLedgerTag()
preallocCache.Set(key, tag, 30*time.Second)
return tag
```
Talia: add unit tests for reconnect/proxy strip cases (proxy may drop session header). Also ensure idempotency key is passed through retries.
Ben: dash-bot: can you add a panel "prealloc_dup_by_route" (ratio) and alert at 0.3%?
dash-bot: panel created and linked to INC-7999.
Iris: ledger reconciliation change: when stream_acks show multiple tags for same (session,offset) within 1s, collapse to earliest-confirmed tag and mark others as provisional duplicates. Add a reconciliation metric for CS.
Vik: I'll open PR for router prealloc cache (#5120). Ben, can you handle reconciliation PR?
Ben: will do, add migration tests and a dry-run mode for reconciliation job.
Talia: timeline: PR -> canary -> monitor 1h -> unpause. If prealloc_dup_rate doesn't fall to <0.2%, we'll rollback.
Iris: also add console UX tweak: show "provisional" badge on tokens from prealloc tags until toolcall confirmed. Helps CS triage.
ops-bot: noted. Postmortem label attached.
Talia: thanks team. Keeping thread for follow-up and runbook edits. :white_check_mark:
